notes: Corpus is gitignored (data/legalbenchrag/) and not redistributed; corpus_sha256 pins the exact file used. Wall time is machine-dependent. This measures segmentation (span containment and enclosure tightness), NOT query-answering accuracy. The detector groups whole sentences under section headings, so one detected clause often spans several labeled spans; enclosures are coarse, which is why token-F1 is low even where containment is high. All 462 referenced files now load: one corpus file_path is stored in NFD (decomposed) Unicode form while the file on disk is NFC, and the script resolves it by retrying the path under Unicode NFC normalization, so sample.unreadable_file_paths is empty. Mean token-F1 is taken over every evaluated span with a non-contained span counted as 0, so it is a deliberate conservative floor rather than an average over only the spans that were successfully contained.
